title: Inceku Ka-Allah Ephakanyisiwe
intro: Uzwa ukunyenyeza komuntu wasendulo, inceku ka-Allah eyakhushulelwa esikhundleni esingaphezu kwesivamile. Lo muntu wayaziwa ngokubekezela okungantengantengi kanye neqiniso eliphelele, futhi wathunyelwa kubantu abafulathela umyalezo. Ungubani lo mphefumulo ophakanyisiwe?
clues: Ngakhethwa ngu-Allah njengomprofethi futhi kukhulunywa ngami ku-Quran Engcwele.
Ngangaziwa ngokubekezela kwami ​​nokuba neqiniso, izimfanelo ezidunyiswa u-Allah.
Ngabiza abantu bakithi ukuba bakhulekele uNkulunkulu oyedwa, kodwa abaningi bangenqaba.
Isikhundla sami saphakanyiswa ngu-Allah, futhi nganikwa isikhundla esiphakeme.
Ngivame ukukhulunywa ngabanye abaprofethi abafana no-Ismail noDhul-Kifl.
U-Allah uthi ngami: 'Futhi samphakamisa samyisa esikhundleni esiphakeme.' (19:57)
verse: And We raised him to a high station. (19:57)
